name: Overthrust Main Line 133 Loop Expansion

values.StartLocation: Rock Springs Compressor Station (Cabin 31), Sweetwater County

researcher_notes: FERC docket CP10-3, Questar Overthrust Pipeline. About 43.3 miles of 36 inch loop on Main Line 116 west from the Rock Springs Compressor Station in Sweetwater and Uinta counties, Wyoming, adding up to 800,000 Dth/d east-to-west capacity. FERC approved September 2010. The Federal Register environmental assessment notice (July 2010) and a Natural Gas Intelligence report on the approval agree with the EIA August 2026 release, sheet 'Historical Projects (1996-2024)', Excel row 678, where the project is spelled 'Maine Line 133 Loop Expansion', status Completed, in service February 2011, 43.3 mi, 36 in, 800 MMcf/d. The EIA release is one origin; the Federal Register and trade press are independent of it. Capacity is Dth/d in the FERC documents and MMcf/d in EIA; staged as EIA states it. Row shape follows P7785 (parent MountainWest Gas Pipeline, expansion project as segment). Owner: Questar Overthrust was the 2011 owner; staged as Williams Companies to match P6898 and P6899, no legal form check done. End location and exact coordinates not found in the sources read. Open risk: P6899 (Overthrust Gas Pipeline, 261 recorded in mi) may already include this loop in its length. Its start, end and diameter are blank, so this could not be checked. A reviewer should compare the P6899 length with the sum of the Overthrust main line and its loops before adding. Route not found; no official GIS located.
